{"reason": "8 failure rows labeled unknown are actually demand-forecast-error in two patterns: forecast-bias with bias-amount 0.065-0.081 (below the 0.1 cut) and market-mismatch events. I lowered the bias threshold to 0.05 and added one branch mapping market-signal-mismatch to 'demand-forecast-error, recovering those rows without touching the supplier-delay rule.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
          (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    ((market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
